paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (DFSZ-level values inferred from paper's stated 'at or near DFSZ sensitivity' claim)
notes: CAPP-MAX (CAPP-12TB) cavity haloscope search over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV) reporting the most stringent axion-photon coupling limits in this range at ~90% CL, assuming axions are 100% of local DM with rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. The paper presents its exclusion in Fig. 22 but no numerical table is provided in the extracted text; data_points are approximate DFSZ-band-level values (g_DFSZ ~ 6.5e-16 to 7.5e-16 GeV^-1 over this mass range) consistent with the paper's statement of achieving 'at or near DFSZ sensitivity'. Some sub-ranges (1.0267-1.0443 GHz, 1.1220-1.1229 GHz) used HEMT amplifiers and have weaker limits; gaps exist at mode crossings.
